scope: Local existence and observable-selection diagnostic; NOT convergence, neural training, or independent real-landmark validation
initialization: Frozen v2 t=1 corruption q_input. Start all candidates at exact sparse LS nearest q_input. Invalid starts are reported without truth repair or selective deletion.
observations: Use shared iid UV noise per vertex, 20 identities; sigma / mean baseline diagonal. Select 24 disjoint interior vertices by farthest-point sampling excluding union of v3 fitting layouts. Alternating 12 for selection, 12 for unused audit. Dense evaluation excludes fitting union and all 24. Noise-free is not triplicated.
smoothness: Uniform original mesh-edge Dirichlet energy of chart correction field B(q-q_input), including zero displacement outside compact support; Gram normalized to trace/6=1. No penalty on absolute q and no dense truth target.
directions: Project gradients into exact null plus relative-singular-value <=0.05 modes, or full six-dimensional space. For combined arm sum separately Frobenius-normalized projected smooth and E/K gradients. Freeze normalization within search; cap coefficient infinity step without true-error scaling.
constraints: Per-identity fitted-anchor MSE may increase by at most 2*(sigma/0.002)^2+1e-12 from sparse optimum. Use unchanged local geometry guard; Armijo 1e-4, at most 12 halvings. Noise bound is known synthetic noise, not a calibrated detector bound.
selector: At each step cap separately: baseline policy chooses smooth candidate minimizing observed selection-anchor MSE only if mean per-identity gain exceeds max(1e-12,2*sample_SE). Augmented policy adds energy and combined candidates; it may replace baseline only if the same paired criterion beats that baseline. E-only policy uses energy candidates vs stay. This is a heuristic with candidate search, not a formal significance test. Audit anchors and dense truth never enter selection.
primary_evaluation: Mean per-identity dense non-anchor NRMSE, relative to selected-smooth policy, plus withheld audit residual and per-identity effects. All identities previously observed; correlated states and seeds are not independent subjects.
local_support_rule: For a layout on noisy cases at primary step: at least 80% starts feasible; augmented policy uses an E-containing arm in >=20% feasible cases; median relative paired gain >1%; positive median paired gain in >=5/7 states and >=2/3 seeds; positive median withheld-audit gain; at most 20% identities materially worsened; alternate-step median paired gain >0; no >1e-9 dense drift on full-rank noise-free starts. All local geometry and observation bounds pass. These exploratory criteria decide whether to invest in a separate closed-loop protocol, not whether first gate or neural training passes.
preserve: No archive reads or real-data mutation. Freeze all source/input hashes before outcome computation. No change to v1-v3. Write a separate v4 directory; incomplete or rejected cases remain visible.
